_comment: Crons removed from vercel.json (hidden from Vercel Schedules / Cron Jobs). The route code still exists. To re-enable, add an entry under `schedules` in vercel.json: name -> { schedule, path, requestMethod: "GET" } (UTC unless `timezone` is set). The /manual routes only had a dummy yearly schedule so they showed a 'Run' button in the dashboard; run them with a Bearer CRON_SECRET request or `vercel schedules invoke` instead.
